title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. X is a smooth projective variety, Y a smooth hyperplane section, and φ: Y → X the inclusion. φ^* and φ_* are the correspondences given by the graph, so φ_*φ^* = L_X, the Lefschetz operator (cup with the hyperplane class). Λ_X and Λ_Y are the 'inverse Lefschetz' operators of the sl2-type decomposition. The p_X^j are the projectors attached to the cohomology grading/primitive decomposition. The page belongs to Grothendieck's programme of proving the standard conjecture of Lefschetz type B ('Λ is algebraic') by induction on dimension through hyperplane sections.

(1) Pushing Λ_Y forward. Using φ_*φ^* = L_X and L_XΛ_X = id − (projectors onto primitive parts), he computes φ_*Λ_Yφ^* = q, with q = id_X − Σ_{0≤j≤n} p_X^j. More generally φ_*Λ_Y^mφ^* = qΛ_X^{m−1}q. So pushforwards of powers of Λ_Y are Λ_X-powers cut down by an explicit projector.

(2) The reverse direction. φ^*Λ_Xφ_* = id_Y − p_E. Here p_E is the projection onto the vanishing ('évanescente') part E of the middle cohomology of Y. That part is the complement of the image of H^n(X), by weak Lefschetz. Since vanishing cohomology is primitive, Λ_Y p_E = 0. Multiplying on the left by Λ_Y and using the compatibility Λ_Yφ^* = φ^*Λ_X(id − Σ_{high j} p_X^j) gives the boxed formula Λ_Y = φ^*Λ_X^2φ_*. Consequence: the algebra C(X) of correspondences generated by algebraic classes and Λ_X contains C(Y). In particular B(X) ⇒ B(Y).

(3) The upward direction. Let p_X^{i,j} be the projectors onto L_X^j P^i(X) (i+j ≤ n). Restriction/Gysin gives φ_* p_Y^{i,j} φ^* = p_X^{i,j+1} in the appropriate range; the margin carries an 'L?' query. So condition D(Y), which apparently means algebraicity of the primitive-decomposition projectors on Y, gives algebraicity of all p_X^{i,j} with j ≥ 1. It does not give the purely primitive projectors p_X^i = p_X^{i,0}, 0 ≤ i ≤ n. He notes this explicitly ('Mais ici on n'a pas les p_X^i pour 0≤i≤n'), identifying the obstruction to the inductive approach: the primitive (middle-degree) parts.
errors: Index bookkeeping is shaky. In the step Λ_Yφ^*Λ_Xφ_* = φ^*Λ_X(id − Σ_{n+1≤j≤2n} p_X^j)Λ_Xφ_*, the bracketed term is annotated as equal to Λ_X (or the projector part as 0). With the naive meaning of p^j (projection onto H^j) and dim X = n+1, this does not literally hold. It needs the specific degree range coming from φ_* or a different convention for the p^j. The final boxed formula Λ_Y = φ^*Λ_X^2φ_* is plausible but its derivation on the page is sketchy.
The relation φ_* p_Y^{i,j} φ^* = p_X^{i,j+1} is marked with 'L?' and its range (i+j < n−1?) is uncertain. Grothendieck himself flags it as doubtful.

ideas.what: Λ of a smooth hyperplane section expressed through Λ of the ambient variety: Λ_Y = φ^*Λ_X^2φ_*, hence B(X) ⇒ B(Y)
ideas.modern_name: Heredity of the Lefschetz standard conjecture B under smooth hyperplane sections
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck / Kleiman (Kleiman, 'Algebraic cycles and the Weil conjectures', Dix exposés, 1968)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (Bombay 1968/1969) states the inductive framework; details appear in Kleiman 1968.

ideas.what: Use of the projection onto vanishing cohomology p_E, with Λ_Y p_E = 0 because vanishing classes are primitive
ideas.modern_name: Vanishing cohomology / weak Lefschetz decomposition H^n(Y) = φ^*H^n(X) ⊕ E
ideas.usually_credited_to: Lefschetz; SGA 7 (Deligne–Katz) in the ℓ-adic setting

ideas.what: Transfer of primitive-decomposition projectors from Y to X via φ_*(−)φ^*, yielding algebraicity of p_X^{i,j} for j≥1 but not of the primitive projectors
ideas.modern_name: Inductive reduction of B (or of algebraicity of Lefschetz projectors) to the primitive / middle-degree case
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kleiman 1968 (reduction of B(X) to B(Y) plus a condition on middle cohomology)
ideas.where_published: Kleiman, Dix exposés 1968, §4; Kleiman 1994 'The standard conjectures' (Motives volume)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working draft of the hyperplane-section induction for the Lefschetz standard conjecture: B(X) ⇒ B(Y), and the obstruction located at the primitive projectors. That material was absorbed into Kleiman's 1968 exposition. It is a nice view of the origin of those arguments, but contains nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: The annotation under φ^*Λ_Xφ_* = id_Y − p_E most plausibly reads 'projection sur partie évanescente E...' (vanishing part), not 'partie correspondant'.
In the Λ_Y line, the '0 ||' above the bracket over 'p_X^j) Λ_X' indicates that the projector term vanishes. It does not say the whole bracket equals Λ_X.
In 'Donc C(X) ... C(Y)' the struck word is overwritten by a short phrase (possibly 'i.e. contient'). The intended meaning is C(X) ⊃ C(Y).
The opening line is roughly 'On a, en vertu du premier groupe' (uncertain). The bracket '[Plus généralement' introduces the Λ_Y^m formula.
The marginal 'L?' sits beside φ_* p_Y^{i,j} φ^* = p_X^{i,j+1}, flagging doubt about that relation.
